about: archive.s1d.me — capture the raw bytes of every page and document of India's public government web, with provenance, into the content-addressed archive. Generic: one task for every host. Reachable hosts run on GitHub runners; India-only hosts run on the geo="IN" India servers. Task "refs" reads the archived texts on GitHub runners and reports exact identifier and tender references for the entity graph. Task "wayback" recovers a host's past pages and documents (every distinct version) from the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, for sites that are gone.
